name: Maharashtra Startup Week
summary: Provides work orders of up to Rs. 15 lakh to startups to pilot their innovative solutions within state departments.
administering_ministry: Department of Skill Development, Employment, and Entrepreneurship
benefit_description: Winners receive work orders of up to Rs. 15 lakh from the Maharashtra State Innovation Society.

criteria.description: The startup's turnover must not exceed Rs. 25 Crore.
criteria.source_quote: The Startup's turnover should not have exceeded Rs. 25 Crore in any of the financial years since its incorporation/registration.

criteria.description: Startups must have a minimum viable product and be ready to demonstrate proof of concept.
criteria.source_quote: Furthermore, startups must have a “minimum viable product” and be ready to demonstrate “proof of concept”.

document_requirements.issuing_authority_name: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the Startup India portal.
Prepare a comprehensive presentation outlining the innovation and business model.

windows.notes: Organised in the last week of April every year.

benefits.description: Work orders for pilot projects up to Rs. 15 lakh.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Paid out according to the successful pilot rollout phases.
benefits.source_quote: Winners receive work orders of up to Rs 15 lakh from the Maharashtra State Innovation Society to pilot their solutions within different state departments.
